brandDescription: BMW is a prestigious German luxury automobile manufacturer renowned for its sporty performance, elegant design, and cutting-edge technology. With a strong presence in the Indian luxury car market, BMW offers a diverse range of sedans, coupes, and SUVs including the 2 Series Gran Coupe, 3 Series, 3 Series Long Wheelbase, and 5 Series. Each model combines dynamic driving dynamics, premium craftsmanship, and innovative features that define the ultimate driving experience.

models.description: The BMW X1 is a premium compact SUV that combines sporty performance with practical versatility. Powered by the B38 turbo petrol engine delivering 134.10 bhp and 230 Nm of torque. Features include 10 Airbags, BMW Live Cockpit Plus, and a luxurious interior.

The BMW X3 is a premium SUV that combines dynamic performance with luxurious comfort. Powered by a 2-litre turbo-petrol engine delivering 187 bhp and 310 Nm of torque. Features include 6 Airbags, Panoramic Sunroof, and advanced technology.

The BMW X5 is a premium luxury SUV that combines powerful performance with exceptional comfort and advanced technology. Powered by a TwinPower Turbo 6-cylinder diesel engine delivering 281.68 bhp and 650 Nm of torque. Features include 6 Airbags, 4-Zone Climate Control, and a panoramic sunroof.

The BMW Z4 M40i is a premium roadster that combines exhilarating performance with open-top driving pleasure. Powered by a TwinPower Turbo 6-cylinder engine delivering 335 bhp and 500 Nm of torque. Features include 4 Airbags, 8-Speed Steptronic transmission, and a luxurious interior.

The BMW M2 is a high-performance sports coupe that delivers exhilarating driving dynamics and track-ready performance. Powered by a 3.0 M TwinPower Turbo inline engine, the M2 offers exceptional power and precision handling. With its aggressive design, advanced technology, and motorsport heritage, it provides an unmatched driving experience for enthusiasts.
